clusters.name: Roll-up of regulated schools
clusters.description: Acquire under-managed accredited schools from aging owners, professionalise operations and bolt on more; returns from EBITDA growth.

clusters.name: Pest control route/company acquisition
clusters.description: Buy a retiring operator's pest control route or small company with recurring homeowner plans, financed via seller note or SBA; revenue from recurring treatment contracts.

clusters.name: HVAC/plumbing company acquisition
clusters.description: Buy an established HVAC or plumbing service firm with SBA financing, keeping name and techs; revenue from service calls and maintenance plans.

clusters.name: Holding company roll-up of trade/home-service businesses
clusters.description: Combine multiple acquired local trade businesses (pest, HVAC, plumbing, etc.) under one holding company funded by existing cash flow.

clusters.name: HVAC distribution roll-up
clusters.description: Buy small HVAC businesses at low multiples and consolidate into a large HVAC distribution company.

clusters.name: Cleaning business acquisition and roll-up
clusters.description: Buy small residential/commercial or remote cleaning businesses cheaply, modernise and combine them for recurring contract revenue and multiple expansion.

clusters.name: Laundromat acquisition
clusters.description: Buy an existing laundromat from a retiring owner with SBA/seller financing and run it via a manager; per-load revenue plus wash-and-fold.

clusters.name: Car wash acquisition
clusters.description: Acquire independent self-serve or automated car washes from retiring owners; per-wash and membership revenue with low labour.

clusters.name: Buy existing vending/ice machine routes
clusters.description: Acquire existing vending routes or distressed ice machine locations to get placements and ongoing machine sales.

clusters.name: Roll-up of investment adviser firms
clusters.description: Private-equity style acquisition of RIAs to pool assets and build scale; fee revenue on AUM.

clusters.name: Portfolio of acquired online/e-commerce businesses
clusters.description: Buy and operate one or more online or e-commerce businesses, diversifying across a portfolio; revenue from underlying product sales.

clusters.name: Media acquisition portfolio
clusters.description: Acquire and hold newspapers, magazines and digital media properties; advertising and subscription revenue.

clusters.name: Buy and modernise aging-owner businesses
clusters.description: Acquire dated businesses (manufacturers, nurseries, etc.) from aging owners and add branding, online presence, systems and distribution.

clusters.name: Buy an existing franchise location
clusters.description: Purchase an operating franchise unit from a retiring or stretched owner at a multiple of cash flow.

clusters.name: Lawn care/landscaping company acquisition
clusters.description: Buy a word-of-mouth lawn/landscaping company with sticky routes, modernise marketing and costs, optionally resell; recurring maintenance revenue.

clusters.name: Buy a Main Street business with SBA/seller financing
clusters.description: Acquire a cash-flowing small business from a retiring boomer with little down via SBA loan, seller note and creative financing, repaid from profits.

clusters.name: Business sourcing service for buyers
clusters.description: High-touch private service that sources acquisition targets for selected individuals; high-ticket fees.

clusters.name: Venture/holding company investment firm
clusters.description: Content-fuelled investment firm doing venture and holding-company deals.

clusters.name: Acquire and monetise apps
clusters.description: Buy underpriced apps, add paywalls/subscriptions and price increases, then hold or flip at 2-4x earnings.

clusters.name: Hostile takeover of public company
clusters.description: Unsolicited offer to acquire a public company (Twitter).

clusters.name: Quality-of-earnings due diligence service
clusters.description: Verify target company financials for business buyers; service fees.

clusters.name: Buy and modernise driving ranges
clusters.description: Acquire run-down driving ranges and turn them into tech-enabled practice venues; ball sales plus monthly memberships and F&B.

clusters.name: RV park/campground/mobile home park acquisition
clusters.description: Source and buy RV parks, campgrounds or mobile home parks off-market or via a fund; revenue from site rentals.

clusters.name: Buy professional service firms and augment with AI
clusters.description: Acquire bookkeeping or home health firms and apply AI workflows to raise capacity and margins.

clusters.name: Equity in exchange for value-add/employer equity
clusters.description: Earn or buy equity in an existing business (employer or under-systemised owner-operator) by adding systems and growth.

clusters.name: Buy and run route distribution business
clusters.description: Acquire a wholesale route or distributor (pastries, souvenirs) selling to retail stores and parks; recurring B2B sales, later sell routes.

clusters.name: Informal small business funding
clusters.description: Give small businesses no-strings capital with voluntary payback.

clusters.name: Buy neglected websites and monetise
clusters.description: Acquire old ranking sites without ads and add AdSense and affiliate offers.

clusters.name: Acquire and grow small software (plugins/SaaS)
clusters.description: Buy small WordPress plugins or niche SaaS tools and grow subscription/licence revenue.

clusters.name: Buy moat-protected local niche businesses
clusters.description: Acquire boomer-owned durable local businesses with location/domain moats (destination rentals, sign companies); rental or job fees.

clusters.name: Minority-stake fund for small businesses
clusters.description: Buy minority stakes in owner-operated businesses to give partial liquidity; preferred returns.

clusters.name: Buy bankrupt companies for email lists
clusters.description: Acquire distressed asset-light companies for their email lists and monetise as ad-supported newsletters.

clusters.name: Acquire a local restaurant (pizza shop)
clusters.description: Buy a neighbourhood pizza shop after testing local demand; food sales revenue.
